name: eformly app
tagline: eformly.app lets users fill forms on PDF online quickly
description: eformly.app lets users fill forms on PDF online quickly. Free tool to sign documents and create fillable web forms. Upload any PDF, drag and drop form fields, and share a link to start collecting submissions as beautiful web forms. We automate the heavy lifting by generating the finalized PDFs instantly. Designed for speed, eFormly also includes tools to quickly fill, sign, and convert your documents on the go. Signature can also be quickly on mobile and pasted to the PDF
